question:
Match the awardees who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award, 2022 in column A with their corresponding dance forms in column B.

 
 

 Column A (Name of the Awardee)
 Column B (Dance form)
 
 

 a. Padma Sharma
 i. Chhau Dance
 
 

 b. Siba Prasad Das
 ii. Bharatanatyam
 
 

 c. Thankamani Kutty
 iii. Kathak
 
 

 d. Smita Rajeshbhai Shastri
 iv. Kuchipudi
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Padma Sharma is recognized for her contribution to **Kathak**.
 
• Siba Prasad Das is renowned for his work in **Chhau Dance**.
 
• Thankamani Kutty is an eminent practitioner of **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• Smita Rajeshbhai Shastri is celebrated for her expertise in **Kuchipudi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**:

 
 
• It is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• Established in 1952, it aims to preserve and promote the vast intangible cultural heritage of India.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**:
 
 
• A classical dance form originating from Northern India.
 
• Known for its intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
 
 
• **Chhau Dance**:
 
 
• A semi-classical dance form from Eastern India, particularly West Bengal, Jharkhand, and Odisha.
 
• Combines martial arts, acrobatics, and storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**:
 
 
• One of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• Characterized by fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**:
 
 
• A classical Indian dance form from Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Known for its graceful movements and strong narrative/dramatic character.
